scope: Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M selector-explicit pp512 SWA attention on gfx1151

repo.qualification: The candidate existed only for the bounded screen and was removed after rejection.

candidate.mapping: three wave32 query heads sharing one qgroup9 KV head
candidate.k8_float_lds: eight keys per tile; 16 KiB LDS; two barriers per tile
candidate.k32_bf16_lds: 32 keys per tile; 32 KiB LDS; two barriers per tile

protocol.timing: one resident owner; warm each mode; five counterbalanced synchronized pp512 repetitions

validation.red: Registry import failed before the qhead3 wrapper existed.
validation.k8_green: The focused registry and wrap/eviction GPU tests passed; full-eight and odd-seven outputs were F32 byte-identical to production qrow4.
validation.k32_diagnostic: The wrap/eviction output differed by at most 6.519258e-09 absolute after BF16 LDS conversion rescheduling; no quality claim was made.

conclusion: Reject and remove. Cross-wave LDS sharing reduces KV loads and workgroups but synchronization and LDS occupancy dominate; the exact K8 route regresses 18.1% and the lower-barrier K32 route regresses 29.7%.
